And taking on their captors now may mean that you find yourself in a conflict that would be forthcoming anyway, but on your terms and timing rather than theirs."
"I have other things to do." (Decline Quest, -1 Local Reputation)

You quickly scan what he handed over to you, and think about the stolen items you found on your target.

A new banner flies above the walls of $(poi_3), and a new set of tax collectors will follow. The locals will not soon forget who failed to protect them. (-2 Local Reputation)
"Well, it seems the land isn't empty, and I need someone to clear out the $(poi_1) which can be found there. You look like the sort that could handle it."

Defeat the mother slime and other creatures in the old sewers and report back.

(Quest Failed)
"Carrying someone's mail doesn't sound like traveling well. No thank you." (Decline Quest)
Your next objective is to defeat any single enemy in a duel. You can find them in a dungeon like this one, or wandering around outside on the world map. To begin a duel, simply walk into the enemy.

A slight whistle alerts you to Acirxes' presence. You're not entirely sure if he has impeccable timing or if he watched you complete your most recent job, but it appears that Sir Donovan has more work for you.
"Some of them were similar. More similar than most golems I've seen in the wild. But no big one this time. And there were several that were like nothing I saw in the library."
Despite the insistence of the compass needle, you decide that you will not finish clearing the $(poi_2). As if it could sense this somehow, the onyx compass disappears. (-2 Local Reputation)

Greetings, adventurer! I have a task that requires your assistance. You see, we have a bit of a situation with a giant insect named Xira. She's been causing quite a stir in our town with her penchant for organizing extravagant balls.
"Consider it done." (Accept Quest)
Then he pulls out a map of a completely different area in a mountainous region to the southwest. "We should go back a step, and make sure the shipment left the mines to begin with."
(Continue)
With several Merfolk defeated, their champions begin to hunt for you.
Find your way back to the entrance once you are ready.
(Continue)
"So long as I get to keep whatever I find along the way too." (Accept Quest).
Travel
"Well I've always wanted to be owed a favor from the rich and powerful. I'll do it." (Accept Quest)
Tree of Tales

She reads over the paper as if seeing this part of it for the first time. "It says here... 'Go to... $(poi_1)... and compete for prizes.' Do you know how to get there?"
Defeating a Merfolk champion will hopefully be enough to turn the tide, so to say.

(Nods) We must confront Teferi, but diplomacy should be our first approach. He's a powerful mage, and if he refuses to cooperate, we may have to resort to more forceful measures to restore temporal stability.

"You've proven yourself to be reliable enough to my organization that I feel I can share its nature, if you have not already surmised it. Put bluntly, my associates and I make our living through the acquisition of information, the discreet sale of it, and occasionally, the role you have been most involved with, its direct application."
"Okay, sure, going somewhere far away seems good right now." (Accept Quest)

The Drunken Plea

Warily take the items.
Head back to town to collect the $(enemy_2) bounty.

Give her the violet flower
Many merchants are peddling their wares, the most relevant to a wizard having colorful (if at times crude) signs in front of their shops advertising their specialties.
You walk away, having your own goals in mind already. (Decline Quest)

Side quests are available in all towns (look for the question mark) and can be a great way to collect extra loot while exploring Shandalar.

"So, a portal?"

"And where did this happen?"

Exactly, Your primary objective is to clear the old sewer of slimes by eliminating their presence and ensuring the safety of the townsfolk. Enter the depths of the sewer, locate the main breeding ground of the slimes, and eliminate their leader to put an end to the infestation. Be warned, however, as the sewer is known to be treacherous and filled with other dangers, such as crumbling infrastructure and toxic gases.
The leaders of $(poi_3) have you to thank for their freedom, and likely their heads. (+2 Local Reputation, +500 Gold)

"DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? ARE YOU THE BEST IN SHANDALAR???" A young girl yells at the top of her lungs at each passer by in the town. Most people come into view already covering their ears, having heard this plenty of times before.
Cover your own ears and keep walking (Decline Quest)

"So what now?"

(Nods) We must act swiftly. Seek out Kiora, reason with her if you can, but be prepared for a fight. Our survival depends on thwarting her dangerous ambitions. Remember, the sea is a powerful ally and a formidable foe.

"My name is Donovan. Sir Donovan to most. And I have an urgent need for mana shards, far more than I can source in any one town."
